diagnostic.help: refine with the alias of another net
diagnostic.message: refine shop.[deliver] by shop: a net cannot refine its own transition

source.text:
composition refined_order_self

use "order_flow.petrinet" as shop
use "courier.petrinet" as courier
wire shop.(sending) -> courier.(pickup)
wire courier.(dropped) -> shop.(delivered)
refine shop.[deliver] by shop
